Localtify 0.5.1 refines the local-first listening experience introduced in 0.5.0. Existing library, themes, offline playback, and Android pairing remain intact.

## Listening experience

- Click the current artwork in the desktop player bar to enter an immersive application-window player with responsive artwork, transport, seeking, volume, queue, lyrics, and connected-device controls.
- Distraction-free controls and flat, artwork-blur, and OLED backgrounds.
- Cleaner shared library and collection layouts, navigation, queue controls, and keyboard focus.

## Reliability

- Guard watched-folder subscriptions and settings against an outdated Electron preload; restart the desktop application to restore unavailable features.
- Retain the existing local playback engine and device synchronization.

## Downloads

- Windows x64: `localtify-setup-0.5.1.exe`.
- Linux x64: AppImage, Debian and RPM packages.
- Android: `localtify-0.5.1-android.apk`, signed with the existing release key.
- Verify packages using `SHA256SUMS`. Desktop packages are not code-signed.
